name: Deathstep - kick flurry and half-time snare
description: A two-bar deathstep drum pattern for a Drum Rack clip: isolated kick hits and a pickup in bar one, then a full sixteenth kick flurry in bar two against the half-time snare on beat three, with swung ghosts on the hats. Renders MIDI into an existing clip; it does not load drum samples.
notes: Deathstep borrows death-metal blast beats as kick flurries between drops; the flurry is placed in the second bar so the first bar still reads as half-time. Aim the clip at a Drum Rack whose pads are tuned to the Set. Sources: Melodigging deathstep notes (https://www.melodigging.com/genre/deathstep), Recording Arts Canada's TenGraphs interview (https://recordingarts.com/record/introduction-of-deathstep).
